description: This file defines the Api class for interacting with Confluence via its REST API, providing methods for page retrieval, creation, updating, deletion, and handling attachments.

classes.name: Api
classes.description: A class to interface with Confluence REST API, providing methods for page management and attachment handling.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Api class with base URL, username, and password.

methods.name: setSpace
methods.description: Sets the space identifier for Confluence pages.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Returns a configured Guzzle HTTP client.

methods.name: handleError
methods.description: Handles errors from Guzzle HTTP responses, enriching exceptions with more context.

methods.name: getPage
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific Confluence page by ID.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of pages under a root page, optionally recursively.

methods.name: createPage
methods.description: Creates a new page under a specified parent ID.

methods.name: updatePage
methods.description: Updates an existing Confluence page with new content and version info.

methods.name: showSourceCode
methods.description: Displays source code with contextual lines and an indicator pointing to a specific column.

methods.name: getAttachment
methods.description: Checks if an attachment exists in a page.

methods.name: putAttachment
methods.description: Uploads or updates an attachment to a page.

methods.name: getFileSize
methods.description: Determines the size of an attachment, either from file or content.

methods.name: uploadAttachment
methods.description: Uploads or updates an attachment, skipping if identical size exists.
